name: Side split
instructions: Warm up well, then slide your feet apart into a side (middle) split facing forward.
Keep both knees straight and point your toes or kneecaps up toward the ceiling, not forward.
Support yourself with your hands, but do not let your hips rest on anything.
Hold your lowest controlled position for 3 seconds.
Have someone measure the vertical distance from the floor to the lowest point of your pelvis (the crotch). Flat on the floor is 0.
